summary.text: Sarah McDonald is a state representative from Oregon House District 16 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election on the Democratic and Republican lines.
A scientist and educator, she co-chairs the House Agriculture, Natural Resources, Land Use, and Water committee, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: McDonald earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Notre Dame in 1994, a graduate degree from Virginia Tech in 2000 and a Ph.D. from Oregon State University in 2007, and has worked as an educator.
Her affiliations include the Oregon Alliance for Gun Safety, the Linn Benton Lincoln Education Service District budget committee and the Oregon School Boards Association legislative policy committee.
McDonald assumed office on January 13, 2025, succeeding Dan Rayfield, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her priorities include access to health care, education, family-wage jobs and affordable child care, and that she supports strict regulation of data centers.
She said she has worked on solid waste management as the representative of a district that hosts a regional landfill.
